concept: A clumsy but lovable rabbit named Benny tries to get ready for a big party, but everything that can go wrong does.
hook: The episode opens with Benny waking up late and rushing around his messy burrow to get dressed
setup: Benny tries to put on his favorite bow tie, but it keeps slipping off. He attempts to grab some breakfast, but spills eggs all over the place. As he's trying to clean up the mess, he knocks over a lamp, causing a chain reaction of events that lead to chaos.
escalation: Benny becomes more and more flustered as things continue to go awry. He tries to fix his hair, but ends up with a ridiculous hairstyle. He attempts to get dressed in his suit, but it gets caught on the door handle and he has to wrestle free. As he's leaving for the party, he trips on his own feet and face-plants into a nearby trash can.
ending: Just as Benny is about to give up, he looks in the mirror and sees himself covered in egg yolk and lamp cord. He bursts out laughing at the absurdity of it all and decides to just show up to the party looking like that. The other partygoers are initially taken aback, but soon everyone is laughing along with Benny's infectious joy.
